text.en: State the new Cartesian sign convention for reflection by spherical mirror. Ans: The Cartesian Sign conventions for spherical mirrors are following: i) The object is always place to left of the mirror. ii) All distance parallel to principal Axis (X-Axis are measured from pole of the mirror. iii)Distance to the left of pole(-ve X Axis) are negative . iv) Distance to the right of the polar (+ve X Axis) are positive. v) Distance measured perpendicular above the principal Axis (along +Y-axis) are taken as positive. vi) Distance measured perpendicularly below the principal Axis (-Y-axis)are taken as negative Draw a ray diagram for image of an object placed at the centre of curvature of a convex lens write the nature position and size of the image formed by the lens. Ans: When the object is at center of curvature on the other side of the lens .the imagee formed is real, inverted and of the same sizeof object.
text.hinglish: Spherical darpan ke liye naya Cartesian sign convention batayein. Cartesian sign conventions spherical mirrors ke liye hain: i) Vastu hamesha darpan ke baayein taraf rakha jata hai. ii) Sabhi doori jo pramukh dhuri (X-Axis) ke saath hai, darpan ke pole se maapi jati hai. iii) Pole ke baayein taraf ki dooriyan (-ve X Axis) negative hoti hain. iv) Pole ke daayein taraf ki dooriyan (+ve X Axis) positive hoti hain. v) Pramukh dhuri ke upar maapi gayi dooriyan (+Y-axis) positive hoti hain. vi) Pramukh dhuri ke neeche maapi gayi dooriyan (-Y-axis) negative hoti hain. Ek ray diagram banayein jo ek vastu ke pratibimb ko darshata hai jo convex lens ke curvature ke kendra par rakha gaya hai, pratibimb ki prakriti, sthal aur aakar likhein. Jab vastu curvature ke kendra par hota hai lens ke doosri taraf, to pratibimb real, inverted aur vastu ke aakar ke barabar hota hai

text.en: Why an ammeter and and a voltmeter are connected in an electrical circuit in series and in parallel respectively? Ans: An ammeter is a low resistance device so it is always connected in series through which the current is to be measured a voltmeter is a high resistance device so it is always connected in parallel through which the potential difference is to be measured. a) Draw magnetic field lines around a bar magnet. MAGNETIC LINES OF FORCE b) A current through a horizontal transmission by flows in East to West Direction .What is the direction of magnetic field at a point directly below it? Ans: Using Right Hand Thumb Rule the direction of field at a point above the line with the horizontal and toward the north and the at a point below will be horizontal and toward the south.
text.hinglish: Ammeter aur voltmeter ko ek electrical circuit mein series aur parallel mein kyun joda jata hai? Ammeter ek low resistance device hai isliye ise hamesha series mein joda jata hai jisse current ko maapa ja sake, voltmeter ek high resistance device hai isliye ise hamesha parallel mein joda jata hai jisse potential difference ko maapa ja sake. a) Ek bar magnet ke ird-gird chumbakiya kshetra ki rekhaen banayein. Chumbakiya balon ki rekhaen. b) Ek current horizontal transmission line mein East se West disha mein flow hota hai. Iske neeche ek bindu par chumbakiya kshetra ki disha kya hogi? Right Hand Thumb Rule ka istemal karte hue, line ke upar bindu par kshetra ki disha horizontal aur north ki taraf hogi aur neeche wale bindu par horizontal aur south ki taraf hogi

text.en: Two lamps one rated 100 watt at 220 volt and other 60 watt and 220 volt are connected in parallel to electric main supply. What current is drawn from the main line if the supply voltage is 220 volt? Ans: current drawn from 100w- I1 = P1/V = 100/220 = 0.4545A Current drawn from 60w I2 = P2/V = 60/220 = 0.2727A Current drawn from the main line, I = I1 + I2 = 0.4545 + 0.2727 = 0.727A
text.hinglish: Do lamp hain ek 100 watt par 220 volt aur doosra 60 watt aur 220 volt jo parallel mein electric main supply se jude hain. Agar supply voltage 220 volt hai to main line se kitni vidyut dhara kheechi ja rahi hai? Vidyut dhara jo 100w se kheechi ja rahi hai - I1 = P1/V = 100/220 = 0.4545A Vidyut dhara jo 60w se kheechi ja rahi hai - I2 = P2/V = 60/220 = 0.2727A Main line se kheechi ja rahi vidyut dhara, I = I1 + I2 = 0.4545 + 0.2727 = 0.727A

text.en: a)State type of defects of vision. Ans: The following are the the defect of vision related to eye vision. i) Myopia or short sightedness.- ii) Hypermetropia or long sightedness. iii) presbyopia iv) Astigmatism v) Cataract. b) Write these eye defects and their correction in brief. i) In short sightedness person can see nearby objects clearly but cannot see distant objects clearly the image is formed before retina and not retina. This defect can be corrected by using concave lens of appropriate power. ii) In long sightedness a person can see distant objects clearly but cannot see nearby objects clearly .A person with this defect has the near point farther away from the normal near point. The image is formed on the retina .The defect can be corrected by using convex lens of appropriate power. iii) In presbyopia one cannot read comfortably and clearly for oldest people do near. Gradually receipts away this effect can be corrected by using bifocal or very focal length which consists of both convex and concave lens. iv) In Astigmatisms a person cannot focus objects both in horizontal and vertical lines clearly. This defect can be corrected by using cylindrical lenses for refractive surgery. v) Cataract is a condition in which crystalline lens of eye becomes milky and cloudy due to growth of membrane over it this it is possible to restore vision for cataract surgery . c) The far point of a myopic person is 80cm in front of the eye. What is the nature and power of lens required to correct the problem? Ans: Concave lens is used to correct the problem. u = – ∞ v = – 80 cm, 1/-v – 1/-u = 1/f 1/-80 + 1/∞ = p P = 100/-80 = -1.25 D
text.hinglish: a) Drishti ke defects ke prakar batayein. Drishti ke defects jo aankhon se sambandhit hain, ye hain: i) Myopia ya short sightedness. ii) Hypermetropia ya long sightedness. iii) Presbyopia iv) Astigmatism v) Cataract. b) In aankhon ke defects aur unke correction ko sankshipt mein likhein. i) Short sightedness mein vyakti nazdeek ki vastu ko spasht dekh sakta hai par door ki vastu ko spasht nahi dekh sakta, pratibimb retina se pehle banta hai. Is defect ko sahi karne ke liye avatal lens ka istemal hota hai. ii) Long sightedness mein vyakti door ki vastu ko spasht dekh sakta hai par nazdeek ki vastu ko spasht nahi dekh sakta. Is defect wale vyakti ka near point normal near point se door hota hai. Pratibimb retina par banta hai. Is defect ko sahi karne ke liye uttal lens ka istemal hota hai. iii) Presbyopia mein vyakti aaram se nahi padh sakta, ye vriddh logon mein hota hai. Yeh dhire dhire khatam hota hai, is effect ko bifocal ya trifocal lens ka istemal karke sahi kiya ja sakta hai. iv) Astigmatism mein vyakti horizontal aur vertical lines dono ko spasht nahi dekh sakta. Is defect ko cylindrical lenses ya refractive surgery se sahi kiya ja sakta hai. v) Cataract ek aisi sthiti hai jisme aankh ka crystalline lens milky aur cloudy ho jata hai membrane ke vikas ke karan. Iska vision restore karna cataract surgery se sambhav hai. c) Ek myopic vyakti ka far point aankh ke saamne 80cm hai. Is samasya ko sahi karne ke liye lens ki prakriti aur power kya hogi? Is samasya ko sahi karne ke liye avatal lens ka istemal hota hai. u = – ∞ v = – 80 cm, 1/-v – 1/-u = 1/f 1/-80 + 1/∞ = p P = 100/-80 = -1.25 D

text.en: a) Draw a circuit diagram for studying Ohm’s law. Ans: b) State Ohm's law. Ans: According to this law the electric current flowing through a conductor is directly proportional to the potential difference applied across its and providing the physical condition such as temperature remain unchanged. c) Draw V-I graph that Verify Ohm's law.State the nature of graph. Ans: The graph is found to be a straight line passing through the origin for Ohmic conductors.
text.hinglish: a) Ohm’s law ke liye circuit diagram banao. b) Ohm's law ko batao. Ans: Is law ke anusar vidyut dhara jo ek conductor se guzar raha hai, wo vibhavantaar ke anupat hai jo is par lagaya gaya hai aur jab tak bhoutik sthiti jaise taapmaan badalta nahi hai. c) V-I graph banao jo Ohm's law ko verify kare. Graph ki prakriti batao. Ans: Graph ko Ohmic conductors ke liye ek seedhi line paayi gayi jo origin se guzar rahi hai
